gbm_population_evidence.quote: Have histologically confirmed World Health Organization (WHO) Grade 4 glioblastoma, other WHO grade 4 malignant glioma or molecular GBM (based on the 2021 WHO Classification) at first recurrence.

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a single center, open-label, Phase Ib trial evaluating the safety and tolerability of CUE-102 monotherapy in adult participants with Glioblastoma (GBM) at first recurrence.
A WT-1-pHLA-IL2-Fc fusion protein, single-use vial, via intravenous (into the vein) infusion per protocol.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase Ib Open-label Study of Adjuvant CUE-102, a WT-1-pHLA-IL2-Fc Fusion Protein in Glioblastoma (GBM) Patients at First Recurrence

role_evidence.quote: evaluating the safety and tolerability of CUE-102 monotherapy

agents.drug_class_hint: CUE-102, WT1 peptide-HLA-IL2-Fc fusion protein (investigational T-cell engaging immunomodulator)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: CUE-102 is designed to target tumor cells by activating T cells

coder_notes: Eligibility also allows 'other WHO grade 4 malignant glioma' (potentially IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 4), with glioblastoma explicitly named, so coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named; gliosarcoma excluded. HLA-A*0201 genotype is an entry requirement but is a germline HLA marker, so not recorded as a tumour biomarker per manual section 5; WT-1 tumour expression is not required. CUE-102 is a fusion protein (therapeutic protein), not coded as a vaccine. 'Adjuvant' in the title refers to post-resection treatment at first recurrence.
